name: PR detail Overview shows the seeded PR Brief and jumps into Files changed
description: From PR #482, confirm the PR Brief section on the default Overview tab renders the seeded pr_brief row that GET /pulls/:id/brief answers: the section label, the summary's opening words, the risk title 'Hardcoded Stripe secret key' with its file reference src/server.ts:88 (the Risk areas live in the Intent card), the Review focus label, and no 'Generate brief' button (AC-83: a brief exists, so the empty state is not drawn). Then the Review focus jump (AC-84): the row 'Open src/config.ts:12 in Files changed' switches to the Files changed tab with ?tab=diff&file=...&line=12, the seeded file src/config.ts is open and the line row carries data-jump-target="line" with the seeded STRIPE_SECRET line in it (the marker persists after the 1,700 ms pulse, so the check does not race it). Read-only: the flow never presses Generate brief or Regenerate brief, so there is no model call and nothing the other flows read changes. The literal strings come from e2e/specs/seed-fixtures.md ('PR #482 has a seeded brief'). SectionLabel text is uppercased by CSS and agent-browser's `wait --text` reads document.body.innerText, so the two label steps lowercase the page text (as flows 11 and 12 do). The absence check looks at button text with an anchored match, because 'Regenerate brief' (the icon button's label) contains 'Generate brief' as a substring. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
